layout: policy[d, bucket, action] = round(255 * P(action)); d = index of the node in plo5bot.tree.DECISIONS (= position among non-terminal NODES); bucket = plo5bot.abstraction.bucket(street, hole, board) of the player to act; action = game.Action value
rows: visited info sets sum to exactly 255 (largest remainder rounding); all-zero row = never visited in training (use a fallback); postflop buckets == 128 are unused
confidence: cfr_conf.npy: uint8 (decisions, 256) = round(4 * log2(1 + w)), w = LCFR-weighted number of average-strategy updates of the info set; 0 = never visited
strategy: Linear-CFR-weighted average strategy of external-sampling MCCFR (dev/cfr/TRAINING.md)

tree_meta.slot_order: legal order of the node: FOLD, CHECK_CALL, RAISE_HALF, RAISE_POT (when legal)
tree_meta.infoset: tree_iset[node] + bucket of the actor on the node's street
